QuestInfo.name: Perfect Stakeout 1
QuestInfo.0: That cat is wearing black sunglasses and carrying a brief case. Not exactly theme park attire, even for a feline. Go see what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: Agent Meow requires balloons for a perfect stakeout. Go defeat the Clowning Scarlions at #m223020000#, and get some balloons for his disguise.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Agent Meow the balloons. That disguise is terrible...

0.1: Meow. C'mon, you'll blow my cover! I know it's not very good cover, but... Ya think you could help?

yes.0: Just listen, meow! \nI'm on a secret mission, and I need to blend in. I'm thinkin' some balloons! Humans always have balloons. Well, humans and Clowning Scarlions...\n

no.0: Shhh, lower your voice! Someone may be listening. Meow.

yes.0: Do I look like I came here to have fun?! \nI'm on an important mission. I'm investigating all the weird stuff going on here, meow. I can't tell you any more than that.

item.0: Could you bring back maybe 20 balloons, meow, from Clowning Scarlions?
